customMethods.name: deleteDebugger
customMethods.script:
loggerId = self.view.custom.loggers.selection.data[0].loggerId
	system.perspective.sendMessage('showInfoToast', 'Deleting logger.....')
	retVal, msg = system.kanoa.logger.deleteLogger(loggerId, self.view.custom.security.userId)

	if msg is None: system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', 'Logger deleted')
	else: system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', "Couldn't delete this logger. \n%s"%msg)
		
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.loggers.data")
	
	return
